newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APEC meeting in Cebu, Philippines, April 5-6.
newsitem.headline: APEC meeting in Cebu, Philippines, April 5-6.

text.p: Finance ministers of 18 member economies of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meet in Cebu, central Philippines, this weekend. Their deputies meet on Friday, April 4 and the main meeting begins the following day. Among those attending are U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin and Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka.
(All times provisional and in local time, which is eight hours ahead of GMT)
1400 - 1800 APEC finance and central bank deputies meeting
0900 - 0930 Welcome ceremonies: Welcome remarks by Philippine
Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo; Keynote address by President
0930 - 1015 Informal meeting and photo session with the president
1015 - 1030 Opening session: Adoption of agenda. Business arrangements
1030 - 1200 Session 1: Current macroeconomic issues and policies for supporting freer flow of capital
1200 - 1400 Session 2: Lunch and dialogue with private sector
1430 - 1600 Session 3: Facilitating private sector participation in infrastructure development and promoting financial and capital market development
1445 - 1500 Remarks by Asian Development Bank president
1600 - 1630 Launching of computerised communications network among APEC finance ministers (Japan)
1900 - 2130 Dinner and cultural show at Plantation Bay Resort Hotel
Voluntary action plan for supporting freer flow of capital (New Zealand)
Enhanced cooperation among export credit agencies (Japan)
Training of bank supervisors and securities regulators (USA)
Strengthening clearing and settlement systems (Hong Kong)
Ratings support for capital markets development (Philippines)
